package.description: Enable IT administrators to distribute updates for software, drivers, and BIOS in a managed environment from a local server.

en-US.description: Enable IT administrators to distribute updates for software, drivers, and BIOS in a managed environment from a local server.
en-US.longDescription: Lenovo System Update downloads updates for software, drivers, and BIOS from a Lenovo server directly over the Internet without requiring specific user knowledge of where the package is located or if it is needed by the target system. System Update can determine which updates are needed and apply them. System Update can also be directed to a local repository managed by Update Retriever
en-US.name: Lenovo System Update

zh-CN.description: 帮助 IT 管理员在托管环境中从本地服务器分发软件、驱动程序和 BIOS 的更新。
zh-CN.longDescription: Lenovo System Update 可直接通过互联网从联想服务器下载软件、驱动程序和 BIOS 的更新，而不需要用户了解软件包的具体位置或目标系统是否需要。系统更新可以确定需要哪些更新并应用它们。System Update 还可以定向到由 Update Retriever 管理的本地存储库。
